items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Because I used to go see him all the time.

ctx.x: He was an old-time musician. Yeah, must have been there. He used to play, he was managing the tuxedo band when Celestine was running. Yeah, and he died around 71 or 72 years of age. Because I used to go see him all the time.
Well, I think of it, I never even got to meet Henry Allen, Sr., the old man. The old man? Well, he died.
He lived about up here, not far from here. Well, he lived right around here on the canal here. That's where he died. Right down here. Right around the corner here on the canal.
